scene_description: Four children are sitting around a campfire in the woods. They are roasting marshmallows on sticks over a fire pit. A green tent is visible in the background, and the children are seated in camp chairs on a dirt ground surrounded by trees.

questions.question: What do you see in the middle of the picture?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the round metal bowl in the center of the picture with orange flames.

questions.question: What are the children doing with their sticks?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at what the children are holding and pointing toward the fire.

questions.question: Where are the children sitting?
questions.evidence_hint: Look at the trees and ground around the children.

questions.question: What is the green thing in the background?
questions.evidence_hint: Look behind the children on the right side of the picture.

questions.question: What might the children do after the marshmallows are done cooking?
questions.evidence_hint: Think about what you do after food is finished cooking.

optional_extension_questions.question: Have you ever been camping or sat around a fire?
optional_extension_questions.evidence_hint: Think about a time you were outside at night or on a trip.
